test.result: 32 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed. Rebalance planner emits only net per-symbol inventory deltas, includes omitted existing inventory as a sell-to-zero target, and fails closed on missing prices.

implemented: Portfolio rebalance preview calculates one signed target-minus-current quantity for each symbol, avoiding close-then-reopen gross-order construction.
Existing holdings missing from the new target are explicit zero-weight targets and require a valid price to liquidate.
Zero inventory deltas are omitted; invalid equity, quantities, target weights or missing prices are rejected.
PaperAccount transaction fees are posted on actual fills, not previewed target changes.
blockers: The preview is not yet the universal paper-runner order planner; strategies and adapters may use other rebalance paths.
Actual execution, partial fills and fee attribution need runner-level prospective reconciliation.
No reduction in real or simulated fees is claimed from this standalone delta helper.
scope_note: Net inventory delta planning and actual-fill fee behavior are tested. Universal runner wiring and execution evidence remain incomplete.
